name: tailed-cursor
title: Tailed Cursor
description: Multiple flat ribbons in orange, green, yellow and blue chase the pointer with a soft spring, bending into curves as they follow. They fade toward their tails over a black surface.
use: A creative portfolio or event landing hero where a bold pointer effect should carry the page's character.
avoid: Needs WebGL and a container with real height, hides the real cursor, and gives nothing for keyboard users.
a11y: A purely pointer-driven WebGL effect with no reduced-motion check and no cue to restore the hidden system cursor. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a black surface, several flat ribbon-like bands of orange, green, yellow and blue lie together in a loose bundle. Each band is a smooth curved strip and they overlap, brightest at the leading edge and thinning toward the tail. The pointer sits near the leading tips.
behaves: Each ribbon is a line of points pulled toward the pointer with spring and friction, so it lags and bends into sweeping curves. When the pointer stops the ribbons curl up and settle; when it moves they stream out behind it.
customise: Set the ribbon colours, spring, friction, thickness, point count, fade and an optional shader wave through props; the GLSL shading is in the source.
weight: heavy: A WebGL render loop with several polylines rebuilding geometry every frame.
